data.one_liner: A Dart and Flutter SDK for OpenAI APIs including GPT-4, GPT-5, o1, and assistants.
data.what_it_does: Connects your Flutter app to OpenAI's advanced AI models, supporting chat completions, streaming SSE, image generation, audio transcription, embeddings, and fine-tuning.
use_when: You want to integrate ChatGPT, DALL-E, or other OpenAI models into a Flutter app.
You need support for server-sent event (SSE) streaming responses from AI models.
avoid_when: You want an on-device machine learning solution instead of a cloud-based API.
You are building an app with Firebase-based AI features and prefer using the official Firebase AI SDK.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of OpenAI APIs including chat completions, assistants, files, audio, and fine-tuning.
Supports modern features such as reasoning models (o1, o3-mini), developer roles, and prompt caching.
weaknesses: Requires managing API keys and handling network communication costs.
data.setup_notes: Requires an OpenAI API token passed during initialization.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using Firebase as the gateway for your generative AI models.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to run local language models instead of relying on a cloud OpenAI API.
